risk_summary: The disclosure is largely precise and well quantified, with detailed year-over-year financial, segment, liquidity, and capital expenditure data. Risk tone is cautiously positive, but the 2018 outlook highlights automotive demand weakness, raw-material inflation, customer pricing constraints, lower backlog, and interest-rate uncertainty. The extensive forward-looking disclaimer is standard boilerplate and somewhat limits accountability for forecast deviations.
